subject: Post-demo follow-up: token economics & model allocation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@fincloud.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-01-08T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: initial token econ & model allocation notes

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment before I put numbers into a short proposal: 

- Current pilot goals: validate chat-assistant flow + semantic search for support KB.
- Initial traffic estimate you gave: ~200M tokens/month during pilot (month 1–2), ramp to ~600M/month by month 3–6.
- Peak QPS: you mentioned 35–45 concurrent requests at busiest times (mostly short chat turns ~60–120 tokens).
- Target budget band you mentioned on call: between $3k–$8k/mo for the pilot phase (you said this was a stretch target).

Model mix we sketched on the call (please confirm):
- Chat generation (primary assistant): ~70% of token volume
- Embeddings (semantic search/upserts): ~25%
- Rerank (relevance scoring): ~5%

A few asks so I can put together an actionable pilot quote:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token volumes (pilot vs target) and whether the 70/25/5 split is representative of your expected steady-state traffic?
2) Do you have sample payloads (anonymized) or a small CSV of sample prompts + average input/output token counts? Helpful to estimate true token mix.
3) Procurement: rough timeline and whether a PO is required for pilot credits.

Next steps I propose: I’ll share a one-page pilot plan + unit-cost worksheet with per-model estimates and a blended spend projection based on the volumes you confirm. If that looks good we can start a 6-week pilot with a $5k credit and a short Dedicated evaluation (if you’re open to a reserved instance trial).

Attaching: short pilot skeleton and a blank payload CSV template (I’ll fill it in once you confirm volumes).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: redwood_pilot_plan.pdf (pilot scope), fincloud_sample_payloads.csv (template)
From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@fincloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-01-09T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: initial token econ & model allocation notes

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volumes: 200M/month was the conservative pilot number — we’re more likely to run ~320M tokens/month in the pilot if all chat features are live. Our roadmap target (post-pilot) is ~1B tokens/month within 6 months if engagement trends as expected.
- Peak QPS: 40–60 (we have regional spikes from APAC late shifts).
- Budget: our finance sponsor gave a very rough target blended cost of ~$30–$40 per 1M tokens for the pilot; we know this is aggressive but need to understand what’s feasible with reserved capacity/commits.

Model mix: mostly aligned with what we discussed, though embeddings could be closer to 30% if we enable more semantic search/freshness. Reranking will be small initially (~3–5%).

I’m attaching a small set of anonymized sample prompts and a high-level traffic forecast. Procurement: we typically need an SOW + PO; pilot credits are fine but we’ll need a statement of work to greenlight any spend with finance.

Can you send a per-model unit cost so I can map to our forecast and see how close we get to that ~$30–$40/1M target? Also add any notes about where committed reserved capacity would materially move the blended price.

Cheers,
Alyssa Cheng
Head of Product, FinCloud
alyssa@fincloud.com

Attachments: fincloud_sample_prompts.csv, fincloud_traffic_forecast.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@fincloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-12T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: initial token econ & model allocation notes

Alyssa —

Appreciate the forecast and sample prompts — very helpful. Based on the sample payloads and the volumes you provided, here are conservative per-model unit estimates for the hosted path (we’ll give better precision for Dedicated/reserved offers in the formal quote):

- Chat generation (context + response): ~$45 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (upsert + query): ~$15 per 1M tokens
- Rerank (short scoring calls): ~$9 per 1M tokens

Using your pilot mix (we’ll use the adjusted 67/30/3 split you noted) and 320M tokens/month, the blended spend looks like: 
- Chat tokens (67%): 214.4M tokens -> ~$9,648/month
- Embeddings (30%): 96M tokens -> ~$1,440/month
- Rerank (3%): 9.6M tokens -> ~$86/month
- Blended total = ~$11,174/month -> equivalent blended unit cost ≈ $34.9 per 1M tokens

Key levers to hit your $30–$40 target:
1) Reserved capacity / committed monthly commit: committing to a 6–12 month reserved contract at a predictable throughput can lower the blended unit cost by ~15–30% depending on commit level. I can model 10%/20%/30% discounts in the quote.
2) Quantization & model selection: using a smaller chat variant for short-turn interactions (we can route long-form responses to a higher-cost model) can reduce chat token unit cost ~10–20% without impacting UX.
3) Caching/prefix KV: if you have repeated prompts (FAQ-style), enabling prefix caching reduces effective tokens billed for generation.

Proposed pilot offer (short form):
- 6-week pilot with $5k platform credit + access to a Dedicated reserved eval (4 GPU equivalent for throughput testing)
- We’ll run two experiments: (A) hosted blended path to validate quality/metrics; (B) Dedicated evaluation to measure latency/unit-cost gains and collect real throughput numbers.
- Deliverables: unit-cost worksheet, mutual action plan, success criteria (50% improvement vs baseline in query latency for search, RU accuracy >85% for rerank).

I attached a simple cost workbook with the blended sheets and a one-pager pilot plan. If this looks ok I’ll draft a short SOW for your procurement team and propose a demo/tech-check next Tuesday to kick off the Dedicated eval.

Questions for you to confirm so I can finalize the SOW:
- Final approved pilot monthly token target (confirm between 200M / 320M / other)
- Final model split (percentages for chat/embeddings/rerank)
- Procurement cadence (who signs SOW + PO timing)

Thanks — looping Marissa (procurement/enterprise lead) to help with SOW and procurement questions.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_unit_costs.xlsx, redwood_pilot_plan.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Hi Alyssa — and Karthik, thanks for the clear numbers.

A few procurement / legal clarifications from our side to help expedite the SOW: 

- For pilot credits we can proceed with a short SOW (1–2 pages) and a purchase order; no full contract is required for the $5k pilot credit. If FinCloud wants the Dedicated reserved eval we usually have a 6-week eval addendum in the SOW.
- Can you confirm who on your side will sign the SOW and whether finance needs an internal approval memo? Example: we usually see a 5–10 business day PO turn for companies your size.
- Security: please flag any required compliance docs (SOC2, IP agreements). We can share a SOC2 summary and an audit contact.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Confirm pilot volumes & final model split — Alyssa (by 2026-01-15)
2) Redwood sends draft SOW + pilot addendum — Marissa (by 2026-01-14)
3) FinCloud signs SOW + issues PO or confirms payment path for pilot — Alyssa/Finance (by 2026-01-22)
4) Tech-check + Dedicated provision — Karthik/Redwood Infra (kickoff week of 2026-01-26)
5) Pilot run & measurement window (6 weeks) — both teams

I’ve attached the standard SOW template and a SOC2 summary for your security team. If you can confirm the signatory and the pilot volume target I’ll get the SOW draft over today.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
